periods.time: Seven Stars opening day, while hospitalized at Hagun
periods.label: 雷切苏醒观战

status.current: wakes from the exhaustion caused by Ouma's Fantasy Form attack and watches Ikki's match from hospital

relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Student council ally at her bedside when she awakens.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Student council vice president still asleep in the neighboring bed.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former selection opponent; she analyzes his odds against Moroboshi and cheers for him.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Former Seven Stars opponent who defeated her by denying Raikiri range.

periods.summary: Toka wakes in Hagun's hospital after the Akatsuki attack and learns that the student council only suffered Fantasy Form damage. She watches the Seven Stars broadcast with Kanata, worries at first about Stella's delayed match, then analyzes Ikki's first-round fight with Moroboshi. Because she has fought both men, she judges that Moroboshi is only slightly favored and explains Moroboshi's spear weaknesses and hidden strengths.

key_events.summary: Wakes in hospital and learns Stella's match was postponed.
Analyzes Ikki versus Moroboshi from the hospital broadcast.
